affected.note: Ranked by the largest single figure published (585,341) because no overall total was given. Published figures announced by Yayoi: 17,137 customers who linked external applications using their Yayoi ID and password between 2021-05-10 and 2021-06-16 (IDs, plaintext passwords and access tokens), and 585,341 users of Yayoi cloud apps whose encrypted credentials were temporarily held at login between 2021-05-18 and 2021-06-16. Yayoi did not say whether the groups overlap. Yayoi IDs are email addresses.

summary.en: Accounting software maker Yayoi found unauthorized access to the single sign-on API of its authentication linkage service, where a malicious script had been planted. Yayoi IDs and passwords of 17,137 users who linked external apps, and credentials of 585,341 cloud app users, may have been exposed.
summary.ja: 会計ソフトの弥生は、認証連携サービスのシングルサインオンAPIに不正アクセスがあり、不正なスクリプトが仕込まれていたことを確認した。外部アプリ連携を行った17,137件の弥生IDとパスワード、およびクラウドアプリ利用者585,341件の認証情報が参照された可能性があると公表した。
